description: Nothing on this statement is wrong, but four lines look wrong. Before March 2026 the member had paid $4,825 of the $4,900 out-of-pocket maximum. Claim 1 shows the same physical therapy service on two dates one day apart, each with the $25 copay, and claim 2's eye exam was approved at $21, below the $35 copay, so the member pays $21 and the plan $0. On claim 3 the ECG's $10 copay is cut to $4 because the maximum is reached on that line, so later lines, including claim 4's X-ray of the chest billed at five times its approved amount, charge the member nothing. A careful reviewer should report no errors.

decoys.rule: Not a duplicate: exact duplicates must have matching service dates (CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual ch. 1 §120.2, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c01.pdf); each visit has its own copay (note K1)
decoys.note: The same therapy service on two dates one day apart is two visits, each with its own $25 copay

decoys.rule: Plan's stated design (evidence of coverage): when the plan-approved amount is less than the copay, the member pays the approved amount and the plan pays $0
decoys.note: The eye exam was approved at $21, below the $35 copay, so the member pays $21 and the plan $0

decoys.rule: In-network out-of-pocket limit, 42 CFR 422.100(f)(4), https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-42/chapter-IV/subchapter-B/part-422/subpart-C/section-422.100; per the plan's evidence of coverage the member pays only up to the maximum and the plan pays the rest
decoys.note: The member reaches the $4,900 maximum on the ECG line, so its $10 copay is cut to $4 and later lines charge nothing

decoys.rule: A provider's charge is its own fee; cost sharing is figured from the plan-approved amount (CMS sample MSN, https://www.cms.gov/Medicare/Medicare-General-Information/MSN/Downloads/Sample-Part-B-Medicare-Summary-Notice.pdf; plan's evidence of coverage)
decoys.note: The X-ray of the chest was billed at five times its approved amount; the member owes nothing because the maximum was already reached

sources.what: Two lines can be exact duplicates only if their dates of service match
sources.source: CMS, Medicare Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04), ch. 1, §120.2 Exact Duplicates, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c01.pdf

sources.what: MA plans must have an in-network out-of-pocket maximum and track what enrollees pay toward it (paragraph (f)(4))
A copay may not exceed the cost of the service (its plan-approved amount), and once this plan's in-network maximum is reached the plan pays 100%
sources.source: eCFR, 42 CFR 422.100(f)(6) (copay no greater than the cost of the service) and (f)(4) (in-network maximum out-of-pocket), https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-42/chapter-IV/subchapter-B/part-422/subpart-C/section-422.100; Medicare.gov, What does Medicare cost?, https://www.medicare.gov/basics/get-started-with-medicare/medicare-basics/what-does-medicare-cost

sources.what: The amount a provider charged is its own fee; the approved amount is what the provider can be paid
sources.source: CMS, What is in your Medicare Summary Notice (sample Part B notice), https://www.cms.gov/Medicare/Medicare-General-Information/MSN/Downloads/Sample-Part-B-Medicare-Summary-Notice.pdf
